leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply the create function from Zustand to construct a new store with state and actions.
Define a TypeScript interface to specify the shape of the global state managed by the store.
Implement state properties within the store to hold primitive and object data types.
Utilize the set function within actions to update the store's state immutably.
Invoke the useStore hook within functional components to access the global state.
Execute actions from the store to modify state in response to user events.
Control component re-renders by subscribing to specific slices of state using selector functions.
Construct a provider-less setup by directly importing and using the Zustand store across components.
Modify state asynchronously by defining and invoking actions that handle promises or side effects.
Return derived state values from the store using computed properties within selector functions.
Assign initial state values when creating the store to set up default application data.
Compare Zustand's approach to state management with other patterns by implementing a basic feature.
